title: A Typst HTML Paper Pipeline for Astro
subtitle: A small architectural note
description: An example academic paper rendered from native Typst source as semantic HTML inside Astro.
abstract: This note demonstrates a dual-target content pipeline in which Typst emits semantic HTML for reading inside an Astro blog and a paged PDF for archival and print use. The renderer remains distinct from Markdown without becoming visually detached from the surrounding website.
